notes.title: [July 25, 2025] Update Notice v1.06.00
notes.notes:
[h3]The final batch of "UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes" songs, a total of 30 songs accumulated now available for play in this update![/h3][p][/p][p][b]We have added the following 5 new songs in today's update:[/b] [/p][p]Rebirth, Immortal Advent（Kuon Theme） 
Pandemonium Party（Uzuki Theme） 
Fierce battle? No way（Ogre Theme） 
Blood Drain -Again-（Eltnum Theme） 
Battle Begins -Again-（Akatsuki Theme）  [/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076010/UNDER_NIGHT_INBIRTH_II_SysCeles/"][/dynamiclink]
Ⓒ FRENCH-BREAD / ARC SYSTEM WORKS
Ⓒ SUBTLE STYLE

[/p][h2]Core System Reworks and Audio Improvements[/h2][p]We've undertaken a significant rework of some core game components to address a major timing issue. 
We discovered that the vastly increased processing power of modern computers, compared to when the original game was developed, was causing the game to load too quickly before the audio could properly sync. 
This resulted in a mismatch between the metronome and the song's beats. To resolve this, we've implemented the following: [/p][p][b]●Audio Calibration Setting:[/b] You'll now find an "Audio Calibration" setting within the "Sound Settings" section of the options menu. 
- We've also relocated all volume settings here for a more streamlined audio configuration. 
- The new Audio Calibration sub-menu allows you to fine-tune the playback delay. You can test against the background music and adjust the value from -5 frames to +5 frames to find the optimal setting for your system.  [/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565144/568620d76d3b11461a66338f00103126944a691a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565144/0d9e3032a41d6ea420ffb82016051322b90c2693.jpg"][/img][/url] [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565144/da710c9a5472062f9a2c0cb60448651fcc0c7cdb.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565144/59d38b77e0099d25e85cb0ce3b9307350352aa16.jpg"][/img][/url][/p][p][b]●Standardized Song Start Times:[/b] Alongside the Audio Calibration, we've manually aligned all songs to a consistent, unison timeline.
- Additionally, several songs have had their BPM (beats per minute) slightly adjusted to more accurately reflect their intended rhythm.  [/p][p]Finally, we've made minor alterations to the background image of "MAGICAL GREETING."[/p]

notes.title: [April 11, 2025] Hot Fix v1.00.02
notes.notes:
We have received reports on the game being unable to transit beyond the title screen for specific PC environments. However, we are facing difficulties in replicating the issue and troubleshooting for the cause, and we need more time to diagnose the issue in order for us to resolve it in whole. 

As such, as a temporary measure, we will be implementing the following in today's update:
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
- Added a "Safe Mode" launch option for the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565144/4f44cb13d3162e1e49001d90a01ad41d4177838a.jpg[/img]
*The "Safe Mode" for this game is a special launch option designed with the sole purpose of avoiding the blackout issue. In this mode, all of the game processes will be solely run on the CPU. 
*Due to the increased workload placed unto the CPU, even if the PC meets the basic requirements listed in the store description, there is a possibility that the user may experience frame drops. And, due to the frame drops, the user's game experience may be affected. 

- Fixed several other minor bugs.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We have also found a couple of other methods to help lessen the load on the CPU, should the user experience frame drops:
- In the game options settings, reduce the Display resolution to a lower value
- (For advanced users only) Open up the Task Manager, and shut down other CPU-intensive applications and/or softwares. Please proceed with caution.

If any user is still unable to play the game despite launching in "Safe Mode", kindly help us by furnishing the following PC information and post a response to the official Bug Reporting thread in the game's Community Hub:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3516620/discussions/0/830458962613735849/

- PC manufacturer and model number (If unsure, a simple "Notebook PC" or "Desktop PC" will suffice)
- OS version (Windows 11, 10, or others)
   > If Windows OS, which edition (Home or Pro)
   > If Windows 11, please inform if you updated from Windows 10, or is it freshly installed
- CPU
- RAM size
- Graphics card
- Storage size (including available space)
- If your user profile folder name on your PC contains any non-alphanumerical letters (symbols (!@#$?_) or etc.(§˜™))
- Symptoms experienced, and if there is any difference between launching the game normally, and in "Safe Mode"

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused. 
We are working to resolve this issue rapidly, and we seek your kind understanding on this matter.
Thank you very much.

notes.title: [April 2, 2025] Hot Fix
notes.notes:
We have identified an issue where specific parts of the game speeds up unintentionally when the user plays in the display setting refresh rate of over 60Hz, thus causing difficulties in controlling the game. 

As such, we have implemented a hot fix patch as below:
- Fixed an issue where the game speeds up unintentionally when the game is played in a monitor with the refresh rate set over 60Hz. 

Thank you for your support.
